verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents Decision Center, where merchants can configure policies at the Sale checkpoint that are applied to orders. That is the product's own decision-policy configuration, but the evidence never shows score-range thresholds or mapping to allow/review/block/3DS step-up actions. missing for 10: documented score-range-to-action mapping, merchant-tunable score thresholds, explicit allow/review/block/step-up 3DS action set, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can map score ranges to actions — allow, review, block, step-up 3DS — and tune thresholds to my own risk appetite instead of a fixed cutoff

citations.quote: If Decision Center is enabled, policies for Sale events can be configured at the Sale checkpoint, and they will be applied to orders created via requests to this endpoint.
